evals.prompt: /kimi-usage when the plan reports detailed weekly remaining and limit values
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `kimi-usage` and shows the detailed weekly remaining/limit values and reset time, plus any reported 5-hour and monthly windows, without inventing totals or exposing credentials.
expectations: Uses the supported `kimi-usage` CLI rather than an undocumented endpoint
Shows the weekly remaining and limit values with the reset time
Also shows reported 5-hour and monthly windows
Does not print an API key or read a credential file

evals.prompt: /kimi-usage when the plan has no weekly limit but reports 5-hour and monthly windows
evals.expected_output: The agent says plainly that Kimi reports no weekly limit for this plan, then shows the actual 5-hour and monthly remaining quotas and reset times.
expectations: Says no weekly limit is reported instead of inventing one
Shows the 5-hour remaining/limit and ratio-derived percentage
Shows the monthly remaining percentage and reset time
Keeps all credentials out of output

evals.prompt: /kimi-usage when the request fails or returns malformed JSON
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the exact generic failure, returns nonzero, and does not retry with a different credential or expose the key in output or curl arguments.
expectations: Returns a nonzero status for request and JSON failures
Uses a generic redacted error message
Does not retry with another credential or endpoint
Keeps the credential out of output and process arguments

evals.prompt: /kimi-usage in Claude Code or ChatGPT Work/Codex when shared memory is unavailable
evals.expected_output: The agent reports shared memory unavailable with the failed tool, keeps deterministic local quota reading available, and does not claim context-dependent readiness or copy credentials between hosts.
expectations: Names shared memory unavailable and the failed memory tool
Keeps the deterministic `kimi-usage` CLI usable without a model
Does not silently skip configured recall or claim context-dependent readiness
Keeps OAuth, privacy choices, schedules, and private records local

evals.prompt: /kimi-usage forecast when the current 5-hour average cannot exhaust before reset, and when a high burn rate exhausts early
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `kimi-usage --forecast`, compares used, remaining, elapsed, and reset values, reports no exhaustion before reset with the estimated remainder in the first case, and names the estimated exhaustion duration in the second. It labels both as current-average estimates, not guarantees, and does not invent a monthly forecast.
expectations: Uses used, remaining, and elapsed time to compute the current average burn rate
Compares time to exhaustion with time to reset
Reports the estimated remainder at reset when no exhaustion is expected
Names the estimated exhaustion duration when it precedes reset
Labels forecasts as estimates and does not invent a monthly forecast
